# scripts/ops/Deploy-AvdDemo.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Deploys a demo host pool and session host into an existing landing zone, then validates that a user can sign in.

| `-Environment` | string | yes |  |  |

| `-SessionHostVmSize` | string | no |  | Empty: the same size as the landing zone's session hosts (memory-optimized E-series by default). |
| `-SessionHostCount` | int | no | `1` |  |
| `-AvailabilityZones` | int[] | no | `@()` |  |
| `-EnrollInIntune` | bool | no | `$true` |  |

| `-TestUserUpn` | string | no |  | A user who should be able to sign in; validated for group membership and licensing. |
| `-FixNtfs` | switch | no |  | Apply the FSLogix-recommended NTFS ACL if the check fails. |
| `-SkipPreflight` | switch | no |  |  |
| `-Force` | switch | no |  | Deploy even if the preflight reports failures. |
| `-TimeoutMinutes` | int | no | `30` |  |
